**Issue #4016 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4016: Patch (part 17 of 20): lint bans raw HTML sinks, and a test keeps the daily email plain text (template injection)
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

Item 17 of #3897: **template injection**. A player's text is rendered as a template or as HTML. First-pass verdict: ✅ covered. There is no template engine anywhere:

- the daily email is plain text (`crates/server/src/daily/notify.rs`), and the usernames in it are only letters, digits and `_` (R1432);
- the unsubscribe page prints fixed strings;
- the client has no `innerHTML` and no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.

Hold it there:

1. **Lint.** In `eslint.config.*`, use the core `no-restricted-syntax` and `no-restricted-properties` rules, so no new package is needed. Over `apps/web`, `apps/edge` and `apps/admin`, ban:
   - the JSX attribute `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`;
   - assignments to `innerHTML` and `outerHTML`;
   - `insertAdjacentHTML`, `document.write` and `new Function`.

   It passes today with zero uses. A future need adds a commented exception.
2. **A server test** that the daily email sends no HTML part (or, if one is ever added, that a username and a match id in it are escaped), and that the unsubscribe page's body is one of its fixed strings whatever `token` it is sent, `<script>` included.

`eslint.config.*` is a review path, so a person merges this one.

### Acceptance

- The lint is on, and `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e` is green.
- The server test passes.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server` and the web tests green.

### Blocked by, part of

Part of #3897. Related: #2629 §6 (the reviewer's "a player's text as HTML" point).

### Difficulty (a guess)

medium: anything that is not hard

### Who does it

The night bot (bot:build)

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44244088078)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Ban raw-HTML sinks in the three apps with the core ESLint rules (no new package), green on today's zero uses, and pin the daily email as text-only plus the unsubscribe page as fixed strings. This covers the template-injection point of #3897 (§9.13 mail, §9.4/R1432 usernames) with enforcement instead of a one-time verdict.

## Files to touch

| Path | New / change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `eslint.config.js` | change | One new `defineConfig` block (item 17 of #3897, cf. the #4009 and #4013 blocks): `no-restricted-syntax` selectors plus `no-restricted-properties` entries, scoped to the three apps, with `ignores` for test files |
| `crates/server/tests/api/daily.rs` | change | One new `async fn` test: Resend body has no `html` part; GET/POST `/api/daily/unsubscribe` with hostile tokens returns exactly the fixed pages |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; no spec note and no new ruling (nothing undecided — enforcement of §9.13 and R1432, not a new decision); no production code (`crates/server/src/daily/notify.rs` already sends `text`-only mail and UUID-parses the token before rendering); no app or e2e sources (zero uses today); e2e specs (out of the task's stated scope; their two `outerHTML` hits are reads, which stay legal). Governing spec: §9.13 (daily mail, RFC 8058 unsubscribe) and §9.4 with R1432 (usernames are letters, digits, `_`).

## Steps

1. In `eslint.config.js`, after the #4013 blocks, add one block:
   - `files: ["apps/web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js}", "apps/edge/**/*.ts", "apps/admin/**/*.{ts,tsx}"]` (covers `apps/admin/worker` and top-level admin files; mirrors #4009/#4013 scope; e2e deliberately not listed — outside the task's scope).
   - `ignores: ["**/*.test.{ts,tsx}"]`: test files legitimately assign `innerHTML` for jsdom setup (`apps/web/src/fx/anchors.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/tutorial/Coach.test.tsx`, etc.), so without this the block fails today.
   - `no-restricted-syntax` (error), one entry each with a message ending `(#4016)`:
     - `JSXAttribute[name.name="dangerouslySetInnerHTML"]` — React's raw-markup escape hatch.
     - `AssignmentExpression[left.property.name="innerHTML"]` and `AssignmentExpression[left.property.name="outerHTML"]` — assignments (including `+=`) only, so reads like the e2e specs' `element.outerHTML` stay legal.
     - `NewExpression[callee.name="Function"]` — the `new Function` constructor.
   - `no-restricted-properties` (error), one entry each, message ending `(#4016)`:
     - `{ "property": "insertAdjacentHTML" }` — markup written straight into the document.
     - `{ "object": "document", "property": "write" }` — `document.write`.
   - No allowlist block: verification (below) shows zero hits in the scoped non-test sources, so a future need adds a commented exception then, per the task.
2. Verify the lint block: run `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e` from the repo root and confirm green. If a non-test source flags, stop — the task's premise (zero uses) is wrong; do not weaken the selector, report it.
3. In `crates/server/tests/api/daily.rs`, add one test after `the_sweep_emails_once_per_account_and_none_when_off_or_without_email` (copy its setup: `two_friends()`, one `daily_game`, `fake_service(StatusCode::OK)`, `app_with` with `mail_api`, `POST /daily-sweep`):
   - Mail half: deserialize the captured Resend body as in that test and assert `mail.get("html").is_none()` (no HTML part is ever sent) while `mail["text"]` still lists the game line. Add a comment on the assert: if an `html` part is ever added, this test must grow escaping asserts for the opponent username and the match id.
   - Unsubscribe half, through `call` (HTML arrives as `Value::String`; assert `body.as_str()` exact equality, copying the literals from `notify.rs:590-591` and `html_page` at `594-603` — do not import the private const):
     - GET with each of `token=` (empty), `token=not-a-uuid`, and percent-encoded `token=%3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C%2Fscript%3E` returns 200 and exactly the full `NOT_OURS` page; assert the body contains neither `alert(1)` nor any `<script>`.
     - GET with a fresh unknown UUID (`uuid::Uuid::new_v4()`) returns 200 and exactly the form page (`Stop the emails about your daily games?` … `action="/api/daily/unsubscribe?token={uuid}"`), proving a well-formed token is echoed only inside the action URL.
     - POST to the `<script>`-token link returns 200 and exactly the `NOT_OURS` page (unknown token unsubscribes nobody).
4. Run the new server test plus the existing sweep-mail test (step 5's commands), then `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

## Tests

- `crates/server/tests/api/daily.rs`, new `async fn daily_email_has_no_html_part_and_unsubscribe_page_reflects_no_token`: asserts the Resend JSON has no `html` key with `text` intact, and exact-equality of the unsubscribe GET/POST bodies for hostile tokens (`<script>alert(1)</script>` included) against the fixed page strings.
- Existing guard in the same file: `the_sweep_emails_once_per_account_and_none_when_off_or_without_email` must stay green (it owns the mail-capture setup the new test copies).
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::daily::daily_email_has_no_html_part_and_unsubscribe_page_reflects_no_token`, then `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::daily::the_sweep_emails_once_per_account_and_none_when_off_or_without_email`, then `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e` from the root.

## Done when

- [ ] New ESLint block is in `eslint.config.js` with the six bans across the three apps, test files ignored, zero allowlist entries.
- [ ] `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e` is green (the task's acceptance command).
- [ ] New server test passes; existing sweep-mail test passes; `cargo test -p jackioh-server` and the web tests are green.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean; no ruling note added or removed (no `spec check` impact).

## Risks

- Selector overreach: a too-broad `outerHTML`/`innerHTML` selector would flag reads (the e2e specs' `element.outerHTML`, web tests' `container.innerHTML`). Avoided by scoping the two property selectors to `AssignmentExpression[left.…]` and keeping e2e outside `files`.
- Test-file noise: `document.body.innerHTML = ""` appears in many web tests. Avoided by the block's `ignores`, not by touching the tests.
- Brittle exact-string asserts on the unsubscribe pages: intentional — the point is the bodies are fixed strings, so any copy change must update the test deliberately.
- `call` percent-encoding: the `<script>` token must be percent-encoded in the path (`%3C…%3E`); a raw `<` may fail at `Uri` parsing rather than exercise the handler.

## Open questions

None. One judgment call is pre-settled and needs no person: if an `html` mail part is ever added, the new test's comment requires its author to extend the test with username/match-id escaping asserts rather than delete the absence assert.
```
